title: Candle
summary: A lit candle illuminates roughly 6 ft and can ignite flammable surfaces. Dip a weapon in it for temporary Fire damage.

fields.Dip: Bonus Action. The weapon deals 1d4 extra Fire for 3 turns. The candle itself deals no direct damage.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
